hero.description: Handcrafted with love in Blantyre using the finest organic ingredients. Each cupcake is a little masterpiece of joy, baked fresh daily for your delight.

about.title: Baking Happiness Since 2009
about.text1: What started as a small kitchen experiment in Blantyre has blossomed into a beloved cakery. We believe that every cake and cupcake should be a little moment of joy – baked with the finest organic ingredients, crafted by hand, and decorated with love.
about.text2: Our recipes have been perfected over 15 years, combining traditional techniques with creative modern flavours. From classic vanilla to exotic matcha, there’s a treat for every occasion.
